crop.semantics: Simulation of the current 58%-height wall image box using object-fit cover and a left subject focus. The crop preserves Maul's complete horned head, both eyes, nose, mouth, chin markings, neck tattoos and upper robe while retaining the luminous duel context on the right.

notes: The selected Lucasfilm frame visibly depicts Ray Park's live-action Darth Maul in The Phantom Menace, not an animated incarnation, the later Solo appearance, concept art or merchandise.
The exact StarWars.com page is titled 'Duel Into The Core | Video | The Phantom Menace' and states that Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan team up against Darth Maul in the Theed Palace power core.
The image preserves Maul's defining red-and-black facial design, cranial horns, yellow-red eyes, black robe and live-action duel lighting.
The unparameterized 1280x720 Lucasfilm JPEG is selected over both a same-size alternate encoding and the public 630x354 derivative of the same frame.
The west-focused 1246x1000 wall crop retains the complete head, face, neck markings and costume rather than cutting the left-positioned subject.
The candidate is not Qui-Gon, Obi-Wan, Darth Sidious, Ray Park unmasked, a poster, logo, recommendation tile, later-era Maul or namesake.
Exact-byte duplicate screening must pass against 2,070 canonical repository hashes.
